findings.title: Run-freshness signal is documentation-only (no scheduled check or alert)
evidence: docs/OBSERVABILITY.md:35-54 defines an age_days check and says it should raise an external alert
grep shows the only occurrence of age_days/freshness is in docs/OBSERVABILITY.md
no workflow runs the freshness snippet or posts to ntfy for stale runs
findings.impact: If audit runs stop completing, nothing fails; the documented signal has no execution path.
findings.recommendation: Add a scheduled job that runs the freshness check and alerts (reuse the lab ntfy workflow pattern).

findings.title: Lab API emits request lines only; no health/metrics for job durations or failures
evidence: tools/lab_api_server.py:77-78 logs the request line only
no /metrics endpoint or structured access log
findings.impact: Failed/slow shell jobs are hard to observe beyond the client's exit code.
findings.recommendation: Log auth/job results with duration and expose counters.

report: Reviewed docs/OBSERVABILITY.md, workflow alerting, and the lab API logging. Grepped workflows/tools for the documented freshness recipe.
